g.text: Example: w = "hello", n = 1, i = 2, c = 'l' ⇒ window = "ell", χ = 0 1 1
= (e, l, l) — 2n+1 = 3 cells, centred at i = 2
The universal automaton is query-agnostic: a dictionary character c enters ONLY
Positions outside [0, |w|) are padded with the sentinel $ (never equal to any c),
so windows near the ends of w keep the fixed width 2n+1 = 3.
